intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
Jaipur National University vs JECRC University is not a single winner. Compare fees, admission tests and the BHM classroom each campus offers.

sections.heading: Jaipur National University vs JECRC University for BHM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Jaipur National University if you want a recorded fee of ₹85,800, in a private BHM setting at Jaipur.
Choose JECRC University if you want a 2022 flagship package record of ₹5 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹80,000, in a private BHM setting at Jaipur.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹85,800 as a tuition figure for B.Sc in Hospitality and Hotel Administration at Jaipur National University. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
Our records show ₹80,000 as a programme total for Bachelor of Hotel Management & Catering Technology (BHMCT) at JECRC University.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Jaipur National University here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

JECRC University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2022, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹12 LPA on B.Sc in Hospitality and Hotel Administration. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for Jaipur National University on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for JECRC University on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Rajasthan. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Jaipur National University's recorded ₹85,800 or JECRC University's ₹80,000 fits your budget for this BHM.
If you want a documented flagship placement year, JECRC University is the clearer record here, because Jaipur National University has no 2020-or-later flagship package on this page.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Jaipur National University or JECRC University?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Jaipur National University and JECRC University differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of BHM classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Jaipur National University vs JECRC University?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹85,800 for Jaipur National University on B.Sc in Hospitality and Hotel Administration; our records list ₹80,000 for JECRC University on Bachelor of Hotel Management & Catering Technology (BHMCT). Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Jaipur National University and JECRC University?
faqs.answer: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Jaipur National University here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Jaipur National University and JECRC University accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for Jaipur National University, and no listed exam on this page for JECRC University. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Jaipur National University and JECRC University in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Jaipur, Rajasthan. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
